title: Pinned widgets are stealing focus from Desktop items
line: With a panel popup pinned open, closing a window opened from the desktop now gives keyboard focus back to the desktop, so Delete works on the selected item.
explanation: When the active window closes, KWin picks the next window to focus from its focus chain and only falls back to the desktop if the chain has nothing usable. Applet popups (pinned Kickoff, calendar, system tray) are in the focus chain but desktop windows are not, so the pinned popup won even though the desktop was focused more recently, and Delete went to the popup. The change makes FocusChain::nextForDesktop skip applet popups, so focus goes to the next normal window or, if none, to the desktop; clicking a pinned popup still focuses it as before.

commits.message:
focuschain: don't pass focus to applet popups when a window closes

A pinned panel popup is in the focus chain while the desktop is not, so
closing a window opened from the desktop activated the popup and keyboard
input like Delete no longer reached the desktop. Skip applet popups there.

BUG: 514722

patches.diff:
From 0ef0e81e5ef300e5417df2c8c37d4951800df7aa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:56:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] focuschain: don't pass focus to applet popups when a window
 closes

A pinned panel popup is in the focus chain while the desktop is not, so
closing a window opened from the desktop activated the popup and keyboard
input like Delete no longer reached the desktop. Skip applet popups there.

BUG: 514722
---
 src/focuschain.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/focuschain.cpp b/src/focuschain.cpp
index ade450f4e7..363ff612ea 100644
--- a/src/focuschain.cpp
+++ b/src/focuschain.cpp
@@ -258,7 +258,7 @@ Window *FocusChain::nextForDesktop(Window *reference, VirtualDesktop *desktop) c
     const auto &chain = it.value();
     for (int i = chain.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
         auto window = chain.at(i);
-        if (isUsableFocusCandidate(window, reference)) {
+        if (!window->isAppletPopup() && isUsableFocusCandidate(window, reference)) {
             return window;
         }
     }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: after closing Dolphin and pressing Delete, del-me is still on the desktop.
With the fix: after closing Dolphin, Delete moves del-me to the trash.

review.text: Filtering out applet popups in KWin's FocusChain::nextForDesktop() fixes the reported window-close repro, and the before/after screenshots confirm Delete reaches the desktop again. However, patching only nextForDesktop() leaves pinned applet popups in the focus chain so FocusChain::getForActivation() can still activate them (for example when switching to an empty virtual desktop), and the change adds no KWin autotest. Excluding applet popups at the focus-chain entry point (wantsTabFocus()) or consistently across FocusChain lookups would address the root cause cleanly.
changes: Investigate returning false from wantsTabFocus() for applet popups so they are not entered into FocusChain at all, or if they must remain in FocusChain for a specific reason, also skip isAppletPopup() in FocusChain::getForActivation() and document why they remain in the chain.
Add a KWin autotest (e.g. in activation_test.cpp or a FocusChain test) verifying that closing a window while an applet popup is shown does not pass focus to the applet popup.
